description.en:
Starts changing the brightness of both screens together to a target level over a number of frames (CMND_BRIGHT_FADE does it for one screen). The call returns straight away; use CMND_IS_BRIGHT_FADE_ALL to wait for it.
Brightness -1.0 is fully black and 0.0 is the normal picture.
Target brightness: -1.0 for black, 0.0 for the normal picture.
Length of the fade, in frames.

true once the fade has been started.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments were given.

examples.case: Darkening both screens at the end of a scene and waiting (real usage, from an event script)
